scope: Explicit level-100 neutral-nature NPC profiles for elite encounters and authored trained-group trainers only. Ordinary random encounters, original bosses, foundation teams, and player saves do not acquire training from this table.

profiles.label: 能力特训完成
profiles.description: 体力+60、攻击+20、防御+30、特攻+10、特防+20、速度+20；另行保留已学的技能特训招式。

sources.evidence: Explicit maximum permanent additions: HP 60, attack 20, defense 30, special attack 10, special defense 20, speed 20.
Period analysis corroborating Rei's classic training additions; independently reviewed during source research.

profiles.implementationBoundary: The retained base total is 532. At level 100 with a neutral nature, adding 160 actual stat points is equivalent to 80 base-stat points, giving 612. The source's separate 610 table uses differing underlying values and is not copied over the catalog. Nature ordering and lower-level scaling are unverified: this profile adds final stat points only to level-100 neutral NPCs. Skill training is separate and grants no player ability training.

profiles.label: 嗜血之力
profiles.description: 在场且存活时，每回合结束恢复最大体力的5%；只装备这一项特训特性。

sources.evidence: Blood seal restores 5 percent HP each turn; the training interface replaces the currently equipped seal rather than stacking all three.

profiles.implementationBoundary: One selected second trait. This remake uses end-of-turn healing, floors fractional HP, heals only the active living owner, and retains the trait across switches. It does not change base stats or claim an equivalent BST.

profiles.label: 邪气凛然
profiles.description: 攻击类技能命中并造成伤害后追加30点伤害，每次技能只追加一次；只装备这一项特训特性。

sources.evidence: Evil seal adds 30 damage to attack-category skills; only one of the three training seals is equipped.

profiles.implementationBoundary: One fixed-damage follow-up per successful damaging physical or special move, including multi-hit moves. Misses, protection, immunity, status moves, damage-over-time ticks, and a fainted owner or target do not trigger it. The fixed follow-up follows existing fixed-damage defenses. Exact historic server ordering is not recovered.

unselectedOptions.label: 石破天惊
unselectedOptions.effect: Attack-category skills have a 5 percent chance to double power.
unselectedOptions.reason: Neither authored trained team selects this third seal. It is recorded as an alternative, not stacked with the selected two.
